a: समाधा — {c3c} U. 1 To place or put together, join, unite. --2 To place, put, put or place upon, apply to; पदं मूर्ध्नि समाधत्ते केसरी मत्तदंतिनः Pt. 1. 327. --3 To install, place on the throne; R. 17. 8. --4 To compose, collect (as the mind); मनः समाधाय निवृत्तशोकः Rām.; न शशाक समाधातुं मनो मदनवेपितं Bhāg. --5 To concentrate, fix or apply intently upon (as the eye, mind &c.); Bg. 12. 9; Bh. 3. 48. --6 To satisfy, clear or solve (a doubt), answer an objection; इति समाधत्ते (in commentaries). --7 To repair, redress, set right, remove; न ते शक्याः समाधातुं H. 3. 37; उत्पन्नामापदं यस्तु समाधत्ते स बुद्धिमान् 4. 7. --8 To think over; Bk. 12. 6. --9 To entrust, commit to, deliver over. --10 To produce, effect, accomplish. --11 To place a burden, load. --12 To assume, take upon oneself. --13 To conceive (in the womb). --14 To establish.

report, narrative, MBh.
appellation, name, KātyŚr.

proclaimed or declared to be (इति), Pañcat.
acknowledged as (comp.), Car.
named, called, VP.
famed, celebrated, notorious, W.

समांशा (आ), f. Sida Cordifolia, L.

a: समादिश् — {c6c} P. 1 To point out, indicate. --2 To inform, tell, communicate. --3 To proclaim, announce. --4 To foretell. --5 To order, command, direct. --6 To appoint, depute, entrust with. --7 To assign, allot. --8 To determine.

m: सम्-आदिष्ट mfn. assigned, indicated, directed, commanded, enjoined, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सम्-आ-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति (ep. also Ā. ˚ते), to run together towards or against, rush at, attack, assail (acc.), MBh.; R.
सम्-आ-गाढ mfn. (√ गाह्) intense, violent (only in -तर, ‘more or most intense or violent’), Kāraṇḍ.
सम्-आ-गलित mfn. (√ गल्) fallen down, fallen, MBh.

सम्-आ-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to come together (in a friendly or hostile manner; also sexually), meet, be united with (instr. with and without सह, or सार्धम्), ŚBr.; ChUp.; MBh. &c.; to come together (as heavenly bodies in conjunction or occultation), VarBṛS.; to come to, come near, approach, arrive at (acc. or loc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to come back, return from (abl.), ib.; to meet with, come upon, find (acc.), MBh. : Caus. -गमयति, to cause to come together, bring together, unite one thing or person (acc.) with another (instr. or loc.), R.; Vikr.
a: समागम् — 1 To come or meet together, assemble. --2 To become joined or united, to associate, keep company with. --3 To have sexual intercourse with. --4 To come together, be in conjunction (as planets). --5 To come near, approach. --6 To return. --7 To find, meet with.

association, assembly of (comp.), MBh.; R.; Kathās.
conjunction (of planets), VarBṛS.
approach, arrival, W.
a: समागमः — 1 Union, meeting, encountering, combination; अहो दैवगतिश्चित्रा तथापि न समागमः K. P. 7; R. 8. 4, 92, 19. 16. --2 Intercourse, association, society; as in सत्समागमः. --3 Approach, arrival. --4 Conjunction (in astr.).

m: सम्-आगम—कारिन् mfn. causing union, MW.
सम्-आगम—क्षण m. the moment of union, Rājat.
सम्-आगम—मनोरथ m. the desire of union, Vikr.
सम्-˚आगमन n. coming together, meeting, union (also = sexual intercourse), MBh.
सम्-आगम—प्रार्थना f. the desire of association, MW.
सम्-˚आगमिन् mfn. coming together, meeting, Ind. Ant.
future, imminent, ib.
सम्-आग˚मोपाय m. means of union, MW.
सम्-आगन्तव्य n. (impers.) it is to be met or approached, Vās.
सम्-आगता (आ), f. a kind of riddle or enigma (the meaning of which is hidden by the Saṃdhi q.v.), Kāvyād.

being in conjunction with (instr.), VarBṛS.
come to, approached, arrived, returned, R.; Mṛcch. &c.
a: समागत — p. p. 1 Come together, met, joined, united. --2 Arrived. --3 Being in conjunction. --4 Approached. --ता A kind of riddle.

m: सम्-˚आगति f. coming together, meeting, union, W.
approach, arrival, similar condition or progress, ib.
a: समागतिः — f. 1 Coming together, union, meeting. --2 Arrival, approach. --3 Similar condition or progress.

m: सम्-आ-गृभाय P. -गृभायति (√ ग्रह्), to seize together or at once, take hold of RV.; AV.

aggregation, summing up, sum, totality, collection, assemblage, multitude, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(in gram.) conjunction or connecting of words or sentences (as by the particle च), Śaṃk.; Prāt., Sch.; Pāṇ., Sch.

compounding of words, a compound (esp. applied to a Dvaṃdva whose last member is in the neuter gender [e.g. अहि-नकुलम्, ‘a snake and an ichneumon’], or to a Dvigu, when it expresses an aggregate; see त्रिलोकी), Pāṇ.
= प्रत्याहार, Vop. (cf. IW. 169 n.)
withdrawal (of the senses from the world), Kām.
contraction, abridgment, L.
a: समाहारः — 1 A collection, an aggregate, assemblage; Māl. 9. --2 Composition of words. --3 Conjunction of words or sentences. --4 A subdivision of Dvandva and Dvigu compounds, expressing an aggregate. --5 Abridgment, contraction, {{consiseness->conciseness||20210104|Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20|}}. --6 Combination of two letters of the alphabet into a syllable (= प्रत्याहार q. v.).

सम्-आहूत See सम्-आ-√ ह्वे.
सम्-आहूत mfn. called or collected together, assembled, summoned, challenged (to fight or to a game of chance), MBh.; Kāv. &c.

सम्-आहनन n. the act of striking upon or against, ĀpŚr., Sch.
सम्-आहर mfn. crushing together, destroying, R.

joined, united, Nir.
struck down, wounded, killed, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
beaten (as a drum), Amar.; Kathās.

gathered, assembled, met, Hariv.; Ragh.; BhP.
taken together, contracted, combined, all, Kāś.; Kathās.
drawn (as a bowstring), Kathās.
related, told, BhP.
accepted, received, taken, W.
a: समाहृत — p. p. 1 Brought together, collected, accumulated. --2 Abundant, excessive, much. --3 Received, accepted, taken. --4 Abridged, curtailed.

withdrawal (of the senses) from (abl.), L.

put to, added (as fuel to fire), AV.
put or placed in or upon, directed, applied, fixed, imposed, deposited, entrusted, delivered over, ib. &c. &c.
composed, collected, concentrated (as the thoughts upon, with loc.)

put in order, set right, adjusted, R.
suppressed, repressed, lowered (as speech), L.
made, rendered, Hariv.
completed, finished, ended, MBh.
concluded, inferred, demonstrated, established, L.
granted, admitted, recognised, approved, Āpast.; Hariv.
corresponding or equal to, like, resembling (comp.), R.; Hariv.
harmonious, sounding faultlessly, L.
सम्-आहित m. a pure or holy man, MW.
सम्-आहित n. great attention or intentness, MW.

सम्-आहित—मति mfn. one who has an attentive mind, Yājñ., Sch.

betting on the battles of animals, Suśr.

an appellation, name (also n.), Pañcar.

a: समाह्वे — {c1c} P. 1 To call together, convoke. --2 To challenge, provoke to battle. --3 To invite. --4 To call, name.

reputation, fame, L.

सम्-आ-√ कृष् P. -कर्षति, to draw together, draw towards, attract, MBh.; to draw away or out, extract, take out, Pañcat. : Caus. -कर्षयति, to draw away, carry off, ib.
a: समाकृष् — {c1c} P. 1 To draw out, extract. --2 To attract.

m: सम्-आकृष्ट mfn. drawn together, attracted, Amar.
सम्-आ-क्लिन्न mfn. (√ क्लिद्) well moistened, wet (with वसु n. prob. = ‘food and drink’), MBh. iii, 13472.
सम्-˚आक्रान्त mfn. trod or stepped upon, MBh.; MārkP.
pressed or borne down, R.
overrun, attacked, assailed, seized upon, Ragh.; Pañcat.; Kathās.
kept (as a promise), R.

सम्-आ-√ क्रम् P. Ā. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, to tread or step upon, MBh.; R.

सम्-आक्रन्दन n. crying, shouting, Bhartṛ.
सम्-आ-क्रुष्ट mfn. (√ क्रुश्) reviled, abused, R.
सम्-आ-कुञ्चित mfn. (√ कुञ्च्) drawn in, brought to an end, stopped (as speech), Naiṣ.

m: स-माली f. a collection of flowers, nosegay, L.

a: समालभ् — {c1c} A. 1 To take hold of, seize. --2 To anoint, smear over. --3 To handle, touch.

समालंबिन् — a. Clinging to. --नी A kind of grass.

सम्-आ-लग्न mfn. (√ लग्) adhering or clasped or united together, closely attached, MBh.
सम्-आ-√ लक्ष् (only ind.p. -लक्ष्य), to look at, behold, observe, consider, watch, MBh.
सम्-आलक्ष्य mfn. visible, perceptible, Sāh.

the sacred texts in general, BhP.

सम्-˚आम्नायिक See पशु-समाम्नायिक.
सम्-आम्य mfn. stretching or extending in length, ib.
समानाभिहार m. intermixture of equal things, Sāṃkhyak.

a: समान — a. 1 Same, equal, like, similar; समानशीलव्यसनेषु सख्यं Subhāṣ. --2 One, uniform. --3 Good, virtuous, just. --4 Common, general. --5 Honoured. --नः 1 A friend, an equal. --2 One of the five life-winds or vital airs, which has its seat in the cavity of the navel and is essential to digestion. --3 A letter having the same organ of utterance. --नं ind. Equally with, like (with instr.); जलधरणे समानमुमापतिः Ki. 18. 4. --Comp. --अक्षरं N. of the vowels अ, आ, इ, ई, उ, ऊ, ऋ, ॠ, and ऌ (opp. संध्यक्षर). --अधिकरण a. {1} having a common substratum. {2} being in the same category or predicament. {3} being in the same case-relation or government (in gram.); तत्पुरुषः समानाधिकरणः कर्मधारयः P. I. 2. 42. --(णं) {1} same location or predicament. {2} agreement in case, apposition. {3} a predicament including several things, a generic property. {4} common government. --अधिकारः generic characteristic. --अर्थ a. having the same meaning, synonymous. --उदकः a relative connected by the libations of water to the Manes of common ancestors; this relationship extends from the seventh (or eleventh) to the thirteenth (or fourteenth according to some) degree; समानोदकभावस्तु निवर्तेताचतुर्दशात्; see Ms. 5. 60 also. --उदर्यः a brother of whole blood, uterine brother. --उपमा a kind of Upamā; see Kāv. 2. 29. --काल, --कालीन a. synchronous. --गोत्र = सगोत्र q. v. --दुःख a. sympathiser. --धर्मन् a. possessed of the same qualities, sympathising, appreciator of merits; Māl. 1. 6. --यमः the same pitch of voice. --वयस् a. of the same age. --रुचि a. agreeing in tastes.

k.v: नभस्वद्वातपवनपवमानप्रभञ्जनाः। प्रकम्पनो महावातो झञ्झावातः सवृष्टिकः। प्राणोऽपानः समानश्चोदानव्यानौ च वायवः। हृदि प्राणो गुदोऽपानः समानो नाभिमण्डले। उदानः कण्ठदेशे स्याद्व्यानः सर्वशरीरगः। अन्नप्रवेशनं मूत्राद्युत्सर्गोऽन्नविपाचनम्. भाषणादि निमेषादि तद्व्यापाराः क्रमादमी॥

euphonic combination (= संधि), VPrāt.
(in astron.) a partic. circle, Sūryas.
composition of differences, reconciliation (-समर्थन), L.

(समासेन, समासतः means ‘in short’, ‘briefly’, ‘succinctly’; एषा धर्मस्य वो योनिः समासेन प्रकीर्तिता Ms. 2. 25, 3. 20; Bg. 13. 18; समासतः श्रूयतां V. 2). --Comp. --अध्याहारः supplying an ellipsis in a compound. --अर्था a part of a stanza proposed to be completed (= समस्या q. v.) --उक्तिः f. a figure of speech thus defined by Mammaṭa: --परोक्तिर्भेदकैः श्लिष्टैः समासोक्तिः K.
